title: Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from the streets of Turkey, made with tender lamb and a blend of spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb cubes, red pepper flakes, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the lamb to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the lamb cubes back to the skillet and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through.
Sprinkle sumac over the lamb and serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
